summary: Iron Rabbit PWA v150 — AI Tools 100 Free AI Tools pack. All 14 tests passed. Pack card renders correctly, install writes exactly 100 tiles across 20 categories × 5 tools each with verbatim URLs, no user notes touched, duplicate detection + Remove Pack + Reinstall all work, outbound tap correctly invokes window.open(url,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer') without opening the editor, hierarchy pop-out still works on pack-installed categories, and FAB new-note flow is unchanged.

issues: React hydration/DOM warning: nested <button> — HierarchyPathButton is a Radix Popover trigger placed inside the parent category-toggle <button>. Fires as a console error on every category row. Pre-existing issue, not new to v150, but worth cleaning up (wrap outer as div with role='button' or move hierarchy trigger outside the category toggle button).

action_items: (Cosmetic) Fix nested-button hydration warning on CategoryGroup/HierarchyPathButton — the category-toggle button contains the category-hierarchy button. React logs '<button> cannot contain a nested <button>' for every row.
(Optional) Add data-testid to note list-row so future tests can click a specific tile without needing to switch to grid/icon view.
critical_code_review_comments: aiToolsPack.js normalizer is clean, deterministic, and never invents data — URLs, titles, categories are all pulled verbatim from aiToolsPack.raw.json.
handleApplyPack correctly uses window.confirm for duplicate detection and preserves existing pack tiles.
handleRemovePack hard-deletes only notes where pack_id === pack.id — user notes remain untouched (verified in P6/P12).
openEditModal + openFullScreen both route special_action='open_external_url' → window.open(url,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer'), and edit modal is correctly bypassed.

rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Only pre-existing cosmetic React hydration warning about a Popover trigger button being nested inside the category-toggle button in CategoryGroup/HierarchyPathButton — invalid DOM per HTML spec (button inside button). Fires as a console error on every category row. Reproduce: open Home in list view with any category present → console shows `<button> cannot contain a nested <button>`. Fix: change outer category-toggle element from <button> to a div with role='button' + tabIndex and manual keyboard handlers, OR move the HierarchyPathButton outside the outer button as a sibling. Not new to v150.
